findings: A call can be issued and its output, served model id and token usage recorded from the session transcript.

The only tool call was SubagentHandback, the harness's delivery mechanism; no file, shell or web tool was used. Tool access is not removed in advance, so separation is checked afterwards from each transcript.
Per-call cost is dominated by the agent's fixed context (~45k cache-creation tokens), far above the frozen 4,500-token per-call envelope.
No sampling controls (temperature, seed) are exposed; outputs are recorded, not reproducible by rerun.
route: Claude Code session Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose, model parameter 'sonnet')
